prompt: What is the difference between organization roles and repository roles?
explanation: Two different ladders: org roles manage the organization (membership, billing, defaults), while repository roles (read through admin) apply to one repository. Teams are how the latter get delivered in bulk.

options.text: Organization roles govern the organization itself (owner, member, plus base permissions); repository roles grant per-repository capabilities
They are two names for the same ladder
Organization roles only apply to public repositories
